contract_checks: Asset selection is separate from current host loader eligibility, which is separate from complete instruction grammar scope. Archive-only selection does not claim a host/container model was loaded.
Readiness performs no embedding, model prediction, download, provider call, training, solver or Lake build. Runtime construction validates finite tensor shapes and metadata only.
The complete input string is screened once; no split, paraphrase, parser target or repaired prediction is fed into planning.

Preparation uses the existing Harbor newline normalization and never rewrites instruction.md. Source hashing now occurs before readiness reads and the existing final task-integrity check encloses preparation.
Grammar and loader operational failures yield bounded enum metadata, no exception text, private paths, source strings, model weights or training rows.
Mismatched explicit local config or selected archive pins still reject preparation, preserving admission integrity; this is distinct from optional grammar/load operational failure.
Receipt bodies contain selected identities, implementation hashes, component hashes and fixed scope text; no instruction bodies or checkpoint payloads are exported.

The compatibility delta accepts only the exact OLD_TREE_SHA256 to NEW_TREE_SHA256 leaf transition; every other implementation field must equal the active owner. Strict current artifacts remain strict.

A detached runtime view changes only the known implementation leaf; caller-pinned checkpoint bytes, weights, target schema, manifests and all other content are retained and validated by the ordinary structured.Runtime.

Both packaging and actual Intent inference call the same shared datasets checkpoint owner; the runtime records that owner in producer pins. Security scalar decoding and general structured checkpoint loading remain unchanged.

independently_verified_tree_change.change: sys import, explanatory docstring, diagnostic print directed to stderr; tree rejection and numerical behavior unchanged

limitations: The local positive control exercises authored scalar controlled language, not arbitrary Terminal Bench prompts.
The unchanged largest-eigenval instruction is out of scope and invokes zero checkpoint/embedding/model calls. Packaging compatibility does not broaden grammar coverage.
Readiness eligibility is not proof of future successful embedding inference, successful decode, formal source meaning, task correctness or token savings.
No full supervisor START, paid model run, official benchmark verifier, formal-logic projection or Lake build is established by this review.
Test runs overlap; their counts must not be added to claim distinct test coverage. Recorded test receipts were inspected, not independently rerun by this reviewer.
Current source hashes are review-time bindings; these pytest commands did not independently retain before/after source pins. The real local qualification does retain matching producer pins.
recommendation: accept bounded optional readiness and exact Intent-only diagnostic compatibility

resolved_findings.issue: Optional codec RuntimeError/OSError could escape readiness and abort preparation.
resolved_findings.resolution: ImportError/OSError/RuntimeError now produce input_scope unavailable and preserve continue_planning; ValueError/TypeError remain out_of_scope; three fault-injection tests added.

resolved_findings.issue: Initial or final checkpoint path read could follow a substituted special file or perform an unbounded final read.
resolved_findings.resolution: Both reads now use bounded O_NOFOLLOW|O_NONBLOCK regular descriptors, pre/open/post named-path identity, exact byte hash and final equal identity/bytes; symlink/FIFO/replacement tests added.
